description: This file defines the 'ConfigJobParameterService' interface in Java, which declares methods related to job configuration management within the Finerae project. It includes method signatures for retrieving and updating job step configurations and fetching related job names.

classes.name: ConfigJobParameterService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for handling configuration of job parameters in the context of the Financial Inclusion project.

methods.name: getBusinessStepConfigByJobName
methods.description: Retrieves job business step configuration data based on the provided job name.

methods.name: updateStepConfigByJobName
methods.description: Updates the step configuration for a given job name using data from a JSON command.

methods.name: getAvailableBusinessStepsByJobName
methods.description: Fetches details of available business steps for the specified job name.

methods.name: getAllConfiguredJobNames
methods.description: Returns a list of all configured job names.
